name: Puerto Rico
summary_text: Puerto Rico: full US federal law and policy apply, including the 2025–26 federal anti-trans measures; Catholic-conservative social norms; no local shield — old +0.08 delta predates the federal escalation. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: United States (0.36) plus a local delta of -0.03. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Know Your Rights: Airport Security | A4TE
sources.claim_summary: Advocates for Trans Equality 'Know Your Rights' guide to US airport security (TSA): body-scanner flags, pat-downs, documentation mismatches, and how to request alternative screening - relevant to Puerto Rico as a US territory under TSA procedures.

sources.title: US State Revokes Gender-Affirming Identification | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch (Mar 2026): 'US State Revokes Gender-Affirming Identification' — Kansas voids birth certificates and driver's licenses not matching sex assigned at birth; US document-policy context relevant to US territories.

sources.title: Puerto Rico activists sharply criticize religious freedom, conversion therapy bills
sources.claim_summary: Washington Blade (April 2019): Puerto Rico activists criticized religious-freedom and conversion-therapy bills moving through the island's legislature.

sources.title: Four same-sex couples join Puerto Rico marriage lawsuit
sources.claim_summary: Washington Blade (June 2014): four same-sex couples joined the Puerto Rico marriage lawsuit challenging the island's marriage ban.

sources.title: Bill to ban conversion therapy for minors blocked in Puerto Rico House of Representatives
sources.claim_summary: Washington Blade (March 2019): Puerto Rico lawmakers blocked a vote on a bill to ban conversion therapy for minors.

sources.title: Puerto Rico governor tells lawmakers to withdraw religious freedom, conversion therapy bills
sources.claim_summary: Washington Blade (June 2019): Puerto Rico's governor told lawmakers to withdraw the religious-freedom and conversion-therapy bills - a win for LGBT advocates on the island.

sources.title: Puerto Rico Enacts Most Extreme Care Ban in America, Targeting Trans People Under 21
sources.claim_summary: Erin in the Morning (July 2025): Puerto Rico's governor signed the most severe ban on gender-affirming care in the United States, outlawing most such care for trans people under 21; civil-rights groups said they would challenge the ban in court.
